businessObject.description: Onboarded employee's staff number, email/login and login date.

field.name: employeeName
field.description: Employee name, copied from the prospect record. Source: scenario. Set by: Assign staff number.

field.name: staffNumber
field.description: Staff number created manually in VAXWORKER by HR. Source: scenario. Set by: Assign staff number.

field.name: workEmail
field.description: Work email, also the Microsoft login name. Source: scenario. Set by: Create email and login.

field.name: loginCreatedDate
field.description: Date the email and login were created (automatic), used for the start-date-to-login KPI. Source: EXTRA FIELD. Set by: Create email and login.

businessObject.description: Prospective hire's offer, contract and KYC details.

field.name: prospectName
field.description: Prospective employee full name. Source: scenario. Set by: Initiate hire request.

field.name: hiringManagerName
field.description: Hiring manager who raised the request (logged-in user). Source: EXTRA FIELD. Set by: Initiate hire request.

field.name: department
field.description: Hiring manager QNAB department the new hire joins. Source: scenario. Set by: Initiate hire request.

field.name: offeredSalary
field.description: Offered annual salary (pay conditions of the offer). Source: scenario. Set by: Initiate hire request, Revise offer.

field.name: employmentType
field.description: Full-time, Part-time, Fixed-term or Casual. Source: EXTRA FIELD. Set by: Initiate hire request, Revise offer.

field.name: employingEntity
field.description: Legal entity: APE or DBY (derived from department), drives contract and finance routing. Source: scenario. Set by: Initiate hire request.

field.name: offerResponse
field.description: Prospect response: Accepted, Declined or Negotiate. Source: scenario. Set by: Record prospect response.

field.name: negotiationNotes
field.description: Negotiation log: prospect requests and hiring manager revisions, appended each round. Source: scenario. Set by: Record prospect response, Revise offer.

field.name: kycReference
field.description: Compliance system Staff KYC record number (KYC details are not stored). Source: EXTRA FIELD. Set by: Verify signed contract / Receive online signature.

field.name: kycOutcome
field.description: Staff KYC result: Passed or Failed, a failed KYC cancels the hire. Source: scenario. Set by: Verify signed contract / Receive online signature.

field.name: startDate
field.description: Contract start date: contract issue date + 21 days. Source: scenario. Set by: Draft and issue contract.
